notes: Seed URL works over https; the Elections page links each election's Clarity site. Clarity elections.json for TX/Robertson returns 404, so the check 1 script was run with the county-linked EIDs (122830, 126055, 126389). Each Clarity site had one or more unreadable early versions (HTTP 404) that are pre-election. The 2026 runoff has a 4:23 PM CDT update with precinct numbers before polls closed (likely early votes). The county also posts reconciliation PDFs; not needed since check 1 settled all three elections.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (precinct numbers in two or more election-night Clarity updates), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122830 (linked from the county page under 'NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL: COUNTY-WIDE'). Election-night updates: 11/5/2024 7:07:09 PM CST (13 precincts with votes, 842 nonzero precinct cells) and 9:06:33 PM CST (13 precincts, 1294 cells). Next update 11/15/2024 3:42:56 PM CST.

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EID 126055 ('MARCH 3, 2026 PRIMARY: COUNTY-WIDE RESULTS'). Election-night updates with precinct votes: 3/3/2026 7:03:34 PM (13 precincts, 2459 cells), 8:17:27 PM (2721), 8:59:24 PM (4099), 9:15:56 PM CST (4235). Next update 3/11/2026.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126389 ('MAY 26, 2026: COUNTY-WIDE RESULTS'). Update 5/26/2026 4:23:27 PM CDT already has 13 precincts with votes (255 cells, before polls closed); election-night updates 7:50:30 PM CDT (283 cells) and 8:31:08 PM CDT (418 cells), both with 13 precincts. Next update 6/2/2026.
